content: An dakdebalid, we-napneggine, dule-mesagwar-imakledimalad yaisulid. Dule-mesagwar-gudimaladi bodidii an daksad, dule-gadi-gadi-e-gwage-imakedi sate gudimalad. Dule-mesagwar-gudimaladi, dule-gadi-gadi-e-gwage-imakedi sate gudimalad. Dule-wemar-mesagwar-imakdimaladi, gangued nikamalad.
Degidbali an binsaded, dule-burgwismaladi, dula-gudimaladba bur weligwar gumalad.
Ar degi-inigwele, amba yoo-gwalulemaladdi, bur bule wemarba weligwar gumalad. Ar ade, we-napneggi ibmar-isgana-imaklemalad amba yoo dakmalad.
An daksabalid, arbaed-dummad-imakedi, degi, ibmar-imakedba-nasgumaiguedi, nobed uked. Wedi binsarsunna imaklebalid, gwage-nunmaked ukbalid.

Dule-wargwenad mimmigansuli gudiid, degi, gwenadgansuli gudibalid, bipisaar arbaed indakdisulid. Bato-ibmar-nikadi amba yeer-itosulid, bur bule ibmar nikubied. Gwen binsasurbalid, doaga ede alamaknai. Gwen werguedgi binsasurbalid. Wedi binsarsunna imaklebalid, arbaed-dummad gued.

content.text: Ar na e-arbadiidgi bur bule ibmar-nuegan nikumalad.
Ar dule-ebogwad na walikaa megmalale, na muchub-muchub uee imakmaloed.
Ar dule walagwen-megerdi, ¿igi na uee itogoe?
Ar ebogwardina, sunna dule-baid-abin ganna gwisgumalad.
Sapingwa-wilesakwagwad binsaed-ibed-gudiid, bur nuedid, rey-sered binsaedsuli-gudiidba.

content: Ar we-sapingwa, esgaryagi-mellesii gusdibe, e-yargine wilesakwaa gwalulesdibe,
degi-inigwele, we-napneggine an daksad, we-sapingwa rey-sorba reyga-megnonikile, dulemala eba nanai damalad.

Ar amba dule-bukidar we-sapingwa-gebe-reyga-megidedgi eba nagusdamar-inigwele, degite, dule-danimarmogoedi amba we-rey gwen yeer dakosurmarmogad. Amba we-ibmala binsarsunna imaklebalid, gwage-nunmaked ukbalid.
